interpretation.plain_speak: Forcing same-round actions onto different arms lets fixed-order catch up as throughput rises, so LM3B was partly bottlenecked by where extra actions went. Earliest-deadline was already spending its six actions effectively enough that more same-round capacity did not save additional dependencies.
interpretation.north_star_question: Separates scheduler distribution loss from raw throughput scarcity. The remaining question is whether earliest-deadline throughput matters when the available intervention window is compressed enough that serial spending cannot deploy the fixed budget in time.
